FIRST-EVER ENCORE GX
I NTRODUCING THE FIRST-EVER
B UICK ENCORE GX
Smart doesn’t just happen. It’s designed. And in the case of the First-Ever
Buick Encore GX, smart is innovated, engineered and crafted as well.
That’s why you’ll find every detail in this five-person SUV cleverly fits the
way your life moves.
IN-VEHICLE TECHNOLOGY With its long list of available technologies,
Encore GX helps you wear the many hats that modern life requires.
Leading the list is Amazon Alexa Built-in, which gives you access to the
same voice-activated features you enjoy from your home.
BUICK DRIVER CONFIDENCE Since smart features can help you enjoy safe
travels, the Encore GX comes standard with Buick Driver Confidence—a
suite of advanced safety and driver-assistance features.
SPORT TOURING Overflowing with attitude, the Sport Touring Package is
the boldest expression of Encore GX style and is available on all trim levels.
Encore GX Essence shown in Deep Azure Metallic with Experience Buick Package and available features.

pages.text:
ENCORE GX SPORT TOURING
SPORT TOURING: BOLD ON BOLD
Add a level of sophisticated athleticism to the First-Ever Encore GX with the Sport Touring Package. Available on
all trims, this package adds striking cues for an even bolder expression of Encore GX style.
Let your true colors fly with exclusive ST features including artfully sculpted front and rear fascias with red accents,
body-color rocker moldings, 18" aluminum wheels with contrasting Dark Android high-gloss inserts and Sport
Touring badging on the liftgate. The streamlined profile is further enhanced by the high-gloss Sport Touring black
mesh grille with eye-catching red details.
EXCLUSIVE BLACK ROOF PACKAGE Encore GX ST is made even more striking with a distinctive blackout look
thanks to an available Black Roof Package. The black roof, black mirrors and black roof rails up the stakes on its
bold design. Available only with White Frost Tricoat, Satin Steel Metallic and Chili Red Metallic exterior colors.
Encore GX Essence shown in White Frost Tricoat with Sport Touring Package, Black Roof Package and other available features.

Encore GX’s highly refined interior offers spacious seating for five and tech-savvy
amenities for all. Stay seamlessly in sync with smartphone compatibility and the latest
Buick Infotainment System.1 Up to 10 devices can be paired with your Encore GX, including
two compatible smartphones at the same time for incoming hands-free calls.2 This smartly
crafted SUV has more than enough technology to make every drive an intelligent one.

refinements like leather-appointed seats, a heated steering wheel, a panoramic moonroof
and an in-vehicle air ionizer.

Cancellation utilizes many measures including triple door seals and acoustic laminated
glass to help reduce, block and absorb unwanted noise.

TECHNOLOGY
THE SMART MOVE FOR MOVING SMARTER
Encore GX offers a number of ways to keep you connected. More importantly, the seamless integration of
these technologies helps you keep your eyes on the road.
AMAZON ALEXA BUILT-IN1 For the first time ever, the same voice-activated functionality available on Alexa
devices at home is now available in Encore GX. For example, you can listen to music, make a phone call
with your Bluetooth-connected phone,2 get directions sent directly to the available embedded Connected
Navigation3 (if properly equipped) and even control your compatible smart home devices4 to do things like
turn on the lights or adjust the thermostat.5
myBUICK MOBILE APP6 When you download the available myBuick mobile app, you can schedule service, get
tips to help improve your driving, access instant offers from select nearby merchants and enjoy other ways to
simplify your ownership experience. When you upgrade to Remote Access,6 you can remotely start and stop
your vehicle, check fuel levels and even set and share notifications for vehicle arrivals and departures.7
APPLE CARPLAY™ COMPATIBILITY8 Enjoy easy access to music and maps from your iPhone,® make phone calls,
send messages and more—all through your vehicle’s touch-screen or with your voice through Siri® (shown
lower left).
ANDROID AUTO™ COMPATIBILITY9 Connect your compatible Android™ smartphone to make calls and access your
favorite apps, text messages and music through the touch-screen or with hands-free, voice-activated technology.

SAFETY AND SECURITY
S ERIOUS ABOUT SAFETY
PERCEIVE Buick Encore GX empowers you with available technologies that help raise your
awareness of the road around you.
PREVENT When certain hazards are detected, available features can trigger alerts to let
you know. Some features offered can even automatically apply the brakes or gently nudge
the steering wheel to help you avoid crashes or reduce their severity in some situations.
PROTECT In the event of a crash, strong structural dynamics, intelligent airbag systems1 and
other advanced safety systems work in concert to help protect you and your passengers.
BUICK DRIVER CONFIDENCE Includes all of the following standard features: Forward Collision
Alert • Automatic Emergency Braking • Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
• Following Distance Indicator • IntelliBeam auto high beams • Front Pedestrian Braking
AVAILABLE DRIVER-ASSISTANCE AND SAFETY TECHNOLOGIES Adaptive Cruise Control–
Camera • Automatic Parking Assist with Braking • HD Surround Vision • Rear Cross
Traffic Alert • Rear Park Assist • Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert
• Head-Up Display • Rear Camera Mirror with Washer
For a detailed look at the active safety technologies available in the First-Ever Encore GX,
please visit buick.com/encoregx/safety.
1 A NOTE ON CHILD SAFETY: Always use seat belts and the correct child restraint for your child’s age and size, even with airbags. Even
in vehicles equipped with the Passenger Sensing System, children are safer when properly secured in a rear seat in the appropriate infant,
child or booster seat. Never place a rear-facing infant restraint in the front seat of any vehicle equipped with an active frontal airbag. See
your vehicle Owner’s Manual and child safety seat instructions for more safety information.
Safety or driver-assistance features are no substitute for the driver’s responsibility to operate the vehicle in a safe manner. The driver should remain
attentive to traffic, surroundings and road conditions at all times. Visibility, weather and road conditions may affect feature performance. Read the vehicle
Owner’s Manual for more important feature limitations and information. buick.com/encoregx/safety

S MART ENOUGH TO BE WHATEVER
YOU NEED IT TO BE
GAME-CHANGING CARGO SPACE With its clever, reconfigurable cargo floor,
Encore GX gives you 2.7 inches of additional cargo height, providing a maximum
cargo space of more than 50 cubic feet.1
FLEXIBLE SEATING Encore GX’s 40/60 split rear seats come standard and help
uncomplicate your adventures. Paired with the flat-folding front-passenger seat,
the 40/60 split offers a sizable diagonal cargo area for greater flexibility.
INTEGRATED ROOF RAILS Encore GX is that rare SUV that manages to make
everything look easy. In case you can’t get it all inside, available integrated roof rails,
dealer-installed accessory cross rails and accessory cargo systems help you bring
more along for the ride.

SECURITY
ONSTAR SAFETY AND SECURITY
DESIGNED FOR ADDED PEACE OF MIND As you travel with the ones you care
about most, available OnStar® is with you to help empower every moment.
With the available OnStar Safety & Security Plan,1 you can have a 24/7
lifeline to specially trained Advisors ready to help if you’ve been in a crash,
your vehicle’s been stolen,2 you’re lost or you need Roadside Assistance.3

restarting. And with available Theft Alarm Notification,2 if your vehicle
alarm sounds, we can let you know via text, email or a phone call.
